sourcePin.limitation: Documented architecture and explanations, not proprietary implementation access or a physical teardown

reasons: Summary accurately reflects source claims about 3MF being open XML-based format for additive manufacturing maintained by 3MF Consortium and published as ISO/IEC 25422:2025

Mechanism descriptions correctly capture containerized XML structure using Open Packaging Conventions (ZIP) and embedded manufacturing attributes like temperatures, feed rates, multi-material regions, and support structures

Unknowns appropriately identify specific technical details not covered in source such as exact internal schema for multi-material assignment, host software translation mechanisms, support structure geometry encoding, and version backward compatibility mechanisms
No unsupported mechanisms or invented execution details present in draft
All factual claims in draft are supported by source text with appropriate qualifiers preserved
